title: Fired-heater SIS — IEC 61511 SIL2 (IndustrialStyle)
description: Story: a process-safety scenario for a refinery fired heater. HAZOP identifies three hazards — high skin temperature, loss of fuel-gas pressure, and pilot flame failure — each mitigated by a dedicated Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) targeting SIL2 per IEC 61511. Alarms follow ISA-18.2. Demonstrates IndustrialStyle: SIL-graded Requirements, trip-logic Features, proof-test intervals as fit criteria. Ten ACs total across functional/unit/e2e levels.

requirements.title: High heater-skin temperature must trigger fuel isolation (SIL2)
Low fuel-gas pressure must trigger burner shutoff (SIL2)
Loss of pilot flame must trigger main-burner isolation (SIL2)

features.title: SIF — high skin temperature: 2oo3 thermocouple vote -> ESD valve close
SIF — low fuel-gas pressure: pressure-transmitter low-low -> burner isolation
SIF — pilot flame failure: UV-IR detector loss -> main burner isolation

narration.intro: Fired-heater SIS — IEC 61511 SIL2 demo. Three HAZOP-derived SIFs, ISA-18.2 alarms.
narration.outro: All SIFs verified: 2oo3 voting, proof-test interval, manual reset. SIL2 target met.
